feature: Canvas zoom control that fades by itself
summary: Zooming the canvas now brings up a small glass zoom control in the canvas's bottom right corner (zoom out, the percent, zoom in, Fit). It fades 5 seconds after the last zoom, comes back when you point at its spot, and a double click on the percent goes to 100%. Same in the picture and video editors.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Open a screenshot and press Command plus.
Take your hands off for 5 seconds and watch the corner.
Rest the pointer on the bottom right corner where it was.
Single click the percent and pick 400% from its list.
Pinch on the trackpad, then try its zoom out, zoom in and Fit buttons.
Open a recording, switch to Edit, and press Command minus.

evaluate: Is 5 seconds the right time before it fades, now that you have used it?
Does resting the pointer on its spot bring it back when you want it, without popping up when you are only drawing near the corner?
It sits 12 pt in from the corner, so it is a few points lower than the tool bar beside it: should it line up with the tool bar's centre instead?
Is the quarter second wait before a single click opens the stops list (so a double click can be told apart) quick enough?
rough: No mock draws this control; your words of 2026-10-07 are the spec, so there is no mock frame to compare against.

Resting the pointer on its exact spot brings it back, and from then on a click there goes to the control, not the picture. Hidden, it is click-through: measured by the walk, a real click at its spot reaches the picture while it is gone and the percent menu takes it while it is up. A drag that starts on the picture and passes through the corner does not bring it up.
Every zoom command brings it up, including Fit when the picture is already fitted, so the key always answers. Window resizes that refit the picture do not.
Pictures are the dark appearance only, over the dark surround and over a white picture at 400% (legible on both, the glass greys behind white). Light appearance was not photographed.
The single click on the percent waits a quarter second before opening its list, the same as the tool bar's percent in Current, so a double click can mean 100%.
